purpose: Choose one calendar date in a popover using react-day-picker.
behaviorProvider: react-day-picker plus Aegis Popover and Button.

component: Detect controlled mode by the presence of the value prop, including value=undefined; otherwise initialize from defaultValue. Selecting a date requests Date or undefined and closes the popup.
Use DayPicker single mode, autoFocus and navigation after the calendar; pass timeZone and disabledDates to it. Use the selected date as initial calendar month.
Associate Field state with the shared trigger and format selected text in en-GB using the supplied timeZone. Disable the trigger when the resolved Field state is disabled.
host: Supply valid Date objects and an intentional timezone policy. Own disabled-date business rules, serialization, validation and persistence; there is no named native date input.

The current disabled prop disables the trigger; it does not itself guard DayPicker selection if the popup was already open or defaultOpen is true. Close/unmount the picker when a workflow must prohibit all selection.

Owned styling belongs to the input token group. Actual nested shared components retain their own group and behavior; preserve four theme/mode mappings and keyboard-visible focus.

limitations: Source-backed requirements, not a current test certification or release approval.
No editable text input, name/form submission, range selection or readOnly API.
Locale presentation is fixed to en-GB in the trigger; calendar behavior depends on the installed react-day-picker version.
Disabled state does not currently close an already-open calendar or block its onSelect callback.
